name: hbm_sfu_store_leaf2_r9_1017

pin_regs.reason: the leaf RTL registers every input at the pin (pure flops: rb/we_q/addr_q/data_q/start_*_q) and every output is a stripe register (calendar/valid/active/done/fault/ordinal/mm); a kit flop stage would add an edge to the priced r9 schedule

structural_change: r9 (SFU-STORE-9 10-17; coordinator decision after r7c4 CLOSED + native FAIL capture 222.0 ps on cfg_we): the flat 22-SRAM store is replaced by ONE replicated bank leaf (this kit: 2 stripes = 4 SRAMs, 2 columns x 2-high abutted stacks (pitch 70.512), W MY / E R0 with rd_out/wd_in facing a 31 um centre channel, >= 20 um pin gutter W / 20 um E), own clock root (default CTS), flop-first pins (pin -> plain flop; reset qualification and launch legality folded into the top in front of the leaf pins), stage-B synchronous reset relay per stripe, registered cfg we/addr/data copy inside the leaf (no control net leaves the leaf), recipe 4 / hold_budget die. All pins on the W face (M4, 4.4 pins/um; N/S faces hold ~0.5-1 slot/um under the M3/M5 straps, r7c4 r5 lesson); stripe words reach the W gutter through the ~25-33 um N/S margins (M2/M4) and the W gutter (M3/M5). Cycles vs r7c: datapath D=4/status 2/reset 4 unchanged; +1 edge on configuration writes only (per-leaf hop in the top).

job.purpose: SFU programme store r9 bank leaf (2 stripes, 4 SRAMs) for ot_hgi_sfu_programme_store_r9 (cluster sfus_<q>: 3x leaf3 + 1x leaf2). NOT for submission until the coordinator reviews the gate (critical tile).
